instructions: Please note that the detected platform is not Shopify, but we will provide the instructions as per Shopify's current admin interface.
To embed a returns reason capture form into a Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Go to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies" > "Return Policy".
2. Click on the "Return Form" section and select "Custom Return Form".
3. In the "Custom Return Form" section, click on the "Add a section" button.
4. Select "Text" as the section type and add a title and description for the returns reason capture form.
5. In the "Custom Return Form" section, click on the "Add a field" button.
6. Select "Text field" as the field type and add a label for the returns reason capture form.
7. In the "Custom Return Form" section, click on the "Save" button to save the changes.
8. To display the returns reason capture form on the returns page, you will need to use Shopify's Liquid templating language.
9. In your theme's "layout.liquid" file, add the following code to display the returns reason capture form:
10. Replace the code in step 9 with your own custom code to display the returns reason capture form.
11. Save the changes to your theme's "layout.liquid" file.
12. Test the returns flow to ensure that the returns reason capture form is displayed correctly.
Note: These instructions are specific to Shopify's current admin interface and may be subject to change.
